title: Harbor packages agent evaluations into repeatable sandboxes
friendlyTitle: Harbor puts AI agent tests in safe, repeatable boxes
summary: Harbor is a framework from the makers of Terminal-Bench for defining agent tasks inside sandboxed environments and using them for evaluation and optimization. It can be installed as a Python command-line tool, giving teams a common way to package tasks rather than passing around ad hoc test setups and result archives.
friendlySummary: Harbor helps developers describe a task and run an AI agent inside an isolated test environment. The same test can be repeated with different models or settings.
whyItMatters: Agents are easier to compare when every model receives the same isolated task, tools and scoring conditions. Repeatable sandboxes can turn “this agent looked good in a demo” into evidence that can run in development and continuous integration.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Fair, repeatable tests make it easier to choose an agent and notice when a change makes it worse. Isolation also reduces the risk of a test touching real systems.
